moat_against: Capital intensity: fleet capex exceeded operating cash flow in FY2023 and FY2024 and has consumed nearly all of it for a decade — owner's earnings positive in only 2 of the last 5 years
Freight-cycle and used-vehicle-price exposure: rental utilization and used tractor/truck pricing swing earnings; revenue was flat in FY2025 (+0.23% YoY)
Penske, Enterprise and customers' own private fleets cap pricing; leverage is structural (net debt $7,447M, plus $1,035M lease liabilities, dcf_numbers.json)
moat_for: Scale North American network: ~240,000 vehicles under management and ~800 maintenance locations (company profile, Oct 2026) — density smaller rivals cannot replicate
Long-term contractual model: over 90% of revenue contractual per management on the Q2 2026 call; seventh consecutive quarter of comparable EPS growth
Integrated offer — Fleet Management, Dedicated Transportation and Supply Chain (~320 warehouses, ~100M sq ft) embedded in customer operations, raising switching costs
moat_justification: Scale network (~240,000 vehicles under management, ~800 maintenance locations across the US, Canada and Mexico) and long-term contractual revenue (management said over 90% of revenue is contractual in Q2 2026) give real switching friction in outsourced fleet, dedicated and supply-chain work. Capped at 5: the fleet model is capital-intensive — capex was $3,234M / $2,683M / $2,135M in FY2023-25 against OCF of $2,353M / $2,265M / $2,594M (financials_history.csv), so conservative owner's earnings were positive in only 2 of the last 5 years; competition from Penske, Enterprise and private-fleet insourcing limits pricing power, and revenue growth has stalled (latest FY YoY +0.23%, 3-yr CAGR 1.78% in dcf_numbers.json). The engine could not compute an ROIC proxy or recent gross margins (operating-income and COGS tags are null in EDGAR for Ryder), so there is no filing-direct ROIC-above-cost-of-capital evidence for a higher score; ROE was 13.2% / 15.7% / 16.3% in FY2023-25 (fundamentals.json), respectable but equity-based and levered (net debt $7,447M).
name: RYDER SYSTEM INC
one_liner: Contractual fleet/logistics platform with a moderate 5/10 moat but no positive normalized owner's earnings — fleet capex consumed OCF in the median window (median OE/share $-10.40 vs latest FY $+10.05) — Tier F on the OE model at $237.00; the equity story rests on comparable EPS ($14.40-$14.80 guided for 2026) and buybacks, not OE.
